name: mesh_symmetrize
does: Make a 3D model (glb/fbx/obj) symmetrical left to right: finds its own mirror plane, cuts it there, keeps one half (the more complete one, or left/right), mirrors and welds it - never doubles the model. Writes the .glb and <name>_symmetry.json (plane turn, kept side); a model that is posed (under 35% mirrors) is refused - LOKI's rig re-poses it first and passes the plane

model.description: the model in the job folder, e.g. refs/dragon.glb

keep.description: auto (the more complete half), left or right

plane_x.description: a known mirror plane x (from LOKI's re-pose): used as it is, no search and no refusal
